description: This source file defines server console commands for the Unvanquished game, including command registration, execution, and various admin and game control functions such as entity management, team control, map rotation, and messaging.

classes.name: TraceCmd
classes.description: Defines a server command for performing collision trace debugging.

classes.name: ShowBehaviorCmd
classes.description: Defines a server command for printing bot behavior trees.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the trace command, performing collision testing based on provided arguments.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Prints the textual representation of a bot behavior tree.

methods.name: Svcmd_EntityFire_f
methods.description: Fires an entity's action based on entity number and optional action argument.

methods.name: PrintEntityOverviewLine
methods.description: Prints a brief overview line for a given entity.

methods.name: Svcmd_EntityShow_f
methods.description: Displays detailed information about a specific entity.

methods.name: Svcmd_EntityList_f
methods.description: Lists all entities, optionally filtered by a string.

methods.name: ClientForString
methods.description: Returns client data for a given string identifier.

methods.name: Svcmd_EntityLock_f
methods.description: Toggles the lock state of a mover entity such as a door.

methods.name: Svcmd_ForceTeam_f
methods.description: Forces a player to join a specified team.

methods.name: Svcmd_LayoutSave_f
methods.description: Saves the current layout with a sanitized name.

methods.name: ConcatArgs
methods.description: Concatenates command arguments starting from a specified index.

methods.name: Svcmd_LayoutLoad_f
methods.description: Loads a layout by setting g_layouts and restarting the map.

methods.name: Svcmd_AdmitDefeat_f
methods.description: Handles a team admitting defeat, triggering related game state changes.

methods.name: Svcmd_TeamWin_f
methods.description: Triggers a team win by self-destructing the opposing team.

methods.name: Svcmd_Evacuation_f
methods.description: Orders an evacuation, sets game state accordingly.

methods.name: Svcmd_MapRotation_f
methods.description: Starts a map rotation with a specified name.

methods.name: Svcmd_TeamMessage_f
methods.description: Sends a team message to a specified team.

methods.name: Svcmd_CenterPrint_f
methods.description: Displays a center-screen message to all players.

methods.name: Svcmd_EjectClient_f
methods.description: Ejects one or all clients with a reason.

methods.name: Svcmd_DumpUser_f
methods.description: Prints user info for a specified player.

methods.name: Svcmd_Pr_f
methods.description: Sends a print message to a specific client.

methods.name: Svcmd_PrintQueue_f
methods.description: Prints the spawn queue for a team.

methods.name: Svcmd_MessageWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for various message commands like admin, say, chat.

methods.name: Svcmd_MapLogWrapper
methods.description: Wrapper for map log command.

methods.name: Svcmd_G_AdvanceMapRotation_f
methods.description: Advances the map rotation.

methods.name: ConsoleCommand
methods.description: Main function to process console commands, dispatching to registered commands.

methods.name: CompleteCommand
methods.description: Placeholder for command completion logic.

methods.name: G_RegisterCommands
methods.description: Registers all server commands and admin commands.

methods.name: G_UnregisterCommands
methods.description: Unregisters all server commands and admin commands.
